'''Dd54639//322T''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] assigned to [[Imperial Recon Unit 42B8/S327]]. Tasked with the elimination of [[Mennac Vanderijar|Mennac]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], dd54639//322T was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trendivar]].
